judgement.reason: Mealie supports PostgreSQL and recipe images can be moved to S3 with a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is appropriate.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME $MEALIE_HOME/data/ (docker/Dockerfile), volume mealie-data:/app/data/ (docker/docker-compose.yml mealie)
reviews.reason: Although DB_ENGINE can select PostgreSQL, the Mealie data directory also holds uploaded recipe images and backups, and no shown line moves those files to S3 or another store, so durable local storage is still needed.
